matched_contracts.chunk_format: gzip JSON with config, exact combo_indices, raw per-cell predictions, and elapsed time
matched_contracts.resume: validate config and combo-index identity before skipping a chunk
matched_contracts.merge: reject missing or duplicate combinations by default; sort by (score, combo_index); retain compact top-N summary
matched_contracts.denominator: all observed cells, including measured probe cells as exact predictions

pathology_adaptations.matrix: retained pathology model-by-protocol score matrix instead of the upstream LLM score matrix
pathology_adaptations.predictor: same logit+bias-ALS family and lambda=0.1, with pathology-selected interaction rank 1 instead of upstream deployed rank 2
pathology_adaptations.candidate_identity: pathology protocol IDs replace upstream benchmark IDs
pathology_adaptations.low_friction_semantics: pre-error input/label pipeline proxy; not the upstream user-declared cheap list and not measured cost

local_strictness_additions: score, model-order, evaluation-order, and allowlist hashes in run configuration
record-order and chunk-config validation during merge
fail-closed stale-run registry after source-matrix drift
optional compiled backend accepted only with hash-bound numerical-equivalence evidence
